intro.label: Pocket
intro.body: Kick on 1 and 3 only, hats on the 8ths, snare on 2 and 4. This is not four-on-the-floor. Bass waits two bars, then plays halves on E.

intro.label: Figure
intro.body: Two halves and nothing else. Root on 1 is the entrance, under the beat-1 kick. Root on 3 is the answer, under the beat-3 kick.

intro.label: Harmony
intro.body: Four bars of Em and no other chord. Bass plants the root in halves only after the backbeat has been heard alone.

intro.label: Missable
intro.body: Bar 3 is two E halves on the root. The straight-8th motor of the verse starts later; starting it here erases the wait.

v1.label: Pocket
v1.body: Kick stays on 1 and 3 with snare on 2 and 4. Bass becomes continuous 8ths: root, fifth, and an octave, glued to that backbeat.

v1.label: Figure
v1.body: 8ths replace the intro halves. Root on 1 starts the motor under a kick. Root on the and of 1 keeps it moving. The fifth on 2 lands on the snare, not on a kick.

v1.label: Harmony
v1.body: The verse leaves Em. Order is Em, G, D, then Am, and each chord gets two bars while the 8th motor keeps the same shape.

insight.title: Em G D Am, two bars each

v1.label: Missable
v1.body: Every bass 8th is straight. The fifth on 2 is on the snare, not a swung offbeat, and treating it as funk 16ths breaks the rock motor.

verse.label: Pocket
verse.body: Kick returns to 1 and 3 and the hats return. The 8th motor flips: the fifth is now on the and of 1, not on beat 2.

verse.label: Figure
verse.body: The fifth moved earlier. Root on 1 still takes the kick. The fifth on the and of 1 is the flip. Root on 2 answers, where verse 1 had put the fifth.

verse.label: Harmony
verse.body: Chords match the first verse: Em, G, D, Am, two bars each. The change is rhythmic, the fifth on the and of 1.

insight.title: Em G D Am, fifth relocated

verse.label: Missable
verse.body: Verse 1 put the fifth on beat 2. Here that slot is the root again on 2, and the fifth already happened on the and of 1.

insight.title: Don't put the fifth back on 2

pre.label: Pocket
pre.body: Kick grows an and-of-2 on the way to B7. Bass keeps straight 8ths but the chords are C then B7, and the last 8th of B7 is D#.

pre.label: Figure
pre.body: C in straight 8ths, not the Em riff. Root on 1 is with the beat-1 kick. Root on the and of 1 keeps the pedal. Root on 2 is still C, against the snare.

pre.label: Harmony
pre.body: The chord move is two bars of C, the VI, then two of B7, the V7. That B7 aims back at Em, which the verse never used.

pre.label: Missable
pre.body: These bars pedal C. Beat 2 is the root again, not B, so the verse's fifth-on-2 riff does not fit.

ch1.label: Pocket
ch1.body: Hats leave and the ride takes the 8ths. Kick adds the and of 2. Bass stays in straight 8ths and the chord changes every bar.

ch1.label: Figure
ch1.body: Chorus 8ths linger on the root, unlike the verse figure. Root on 1 has the kick. Root on the and of 1 continues the 8ths. Root on 2 is still the root.

ch1.label: Harmony
ch1.body: Harmony changes every bar: Em then C then G then D, and that group plays twice. C and D were not neighbors in the verse.

insight.title: A new loop, one bar each

ch1.label: Missable
ch1.body: On the Em chorus bars, beat 2 is still the root. Dropping to B there copies the verse figure onto a different bar.

insight.title: Don't keep the verse's fifth on 2

chorus.label: Pocket
chorus.body: The chorus ride and the and-of-2 kick return. After one pass of the loop the last four bars stay on Em instead of cadencing away.

insight.title: Ride and pushed kick, then Em

chorus.label: Figure
chorus.body: Ending reuses the chorus 8ths, then stays home. Root on 1 takes the opening kick. Root on the and of 1 keeps the motor. Root on 2 is still the root.

chorus.label: Harmony
chorus.body: Harmony brings Em then C then G then D back for one bar each, then Em stays. The first chorus repeated its loop; this one stops.

chorus.label: Missable
chorus.body: The last four bars are the Em chord, not another D. Moving to D there copies the middle of the loop after the song has already landed.

insight.title: Don't cadence to D at the end

v2.label: Pocket
v2.body: Kick returns to 1 and 3 and the hats return. The 8th motor flips: the fifth is now on the and of 1, not on beat 2.

v2.label: Figure
v2.body: The fifth moved earlier. Root on 1 still takes the kick. The fifth on the and of 1 is the flip. Root on 2 answers, where verse 1 had put the fifth.

v2.label: Harmony
v2.body: Chords match the first verse: Em, G, D, Am, two bars each. The change is rhythmic, the fifth on the and of 1.

insight.title: Em G D Am, fifth relocated

v2.label: Missable
v2.body: Verse 1 put the fifth on beat 2. Here that slot is the root again on 2, and the fifth already happened on the and of 1.

insight.title: Don't put the fifth back on 2

br.label: Pocket
br.body: Kick on 1 and 3 and 8th hats keep going. Bass drops from the 8th motor to a half note, a dotted quarter, and one short 8th.

br.label: Figure
br.body: Held notes instead of the 8th motor. Root on 1 is a half under the first kick. The fifth on 3 meets the second kick. Root on the and of 4 is the only short attack.

br.label: Harmony
br.body: The breakdown moves C, G, D, then B7. B7 points back at Em, and the bass holds roots and fifths instead of running 8ths.

insight.title: C G D B7, bass in long notes

br.label: Missable
br.body: Beat 1 is a half-note root. The straight-8th motor from the chorus does not belong under a bar that is mostly held.
